mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.title AS title, i.file_url AS imgUrl, a.session AS session, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.created_at AS auctionDate, string_agg(t.tag_name, ', ') AS tags FROM auction a JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key JOIN ( SELECT prod_key, MIN(reg_date) AS min_regdate FROM file GROUP BY prod_key ) fi ON p.prod_key = fi.prod_key JOIN file i ON i.prod_key = fi.prod_key AND i.reg_date = fi.min_regdate LEFT JOIN auctiontag at ON a.auction_id = at.auc_key LEFT JOIN tag t ON at.tag_key = t.tag_key WHERE a.host_id = #{loginId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.title, i.file_urls, a.session, a.created_at, a.start_time, a.end_time

SELECT a.auction_id AS auctionId, a.session, a.title, u.user_name AS auctioneer, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, COUNT(p.prod_key) AS itemCount FROM auction a LEFT JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.login_id WHERE a.auction_id = #{auctionId} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.session, a.title, u.user_name, a.start_time, a.end_time;

SELECT p.prod_key AS prodId, p.prod_name AS prodName, ( SELECT f.file_url FROM file f WHERE f.prod_key = p.prod_key LIMIT 1 ) AS image, p.final_price AS price, u.nickname AS winner FROM product p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.winner_id = u.user_key WHERE p.auc_key = #{auctionId};

SELECT p.prod_key AS prodId, p.prod_name AS prodName, ( SELECT f.file_url FROM file f WHERE f.prod_key = p.prod_key LIMIT 1 ) AS image, p.final_price AS price FROM product p WHERE p.winner_id = #{userKey} ORDER BY p.prod_key DESC

SELECT a.auction_id, to_char(a.start_time, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS date, a.title, -- 대표 이미지 하나만 서브쿼리로 가져오기 ( SELECT f.file_url FROM product p2 LEFT JOIN file f ON p2.prod_key = f.prod_key WHERE p2.auc_key = a.auction_id ORDER BY f.reg_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status, a.view_count AS guestCount, u.user_name AS hostName, COALESCE(string_agg(t.tag_name, ','), '') AS tags FROM auction a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN auctiontag at ON a.auction_id = at.auc_key LEFT JOIN tag t ON at.tag_key = t.tag_key
to_char(a.start_time, 'YYYY.MM.DD') = #{date}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auctiontag at2 JOIN tag t2 ON at2.tag_key = t2.tag_key WHERE at2.auc_key = a.auction_id AND t2.tag_name = #{tag} )
GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.start_time, a.title, a.end_time, a.status, a.view_count, u.user_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction(host_id, created_at, title, start_time, end_time, status, thumbnail_url) VALUES (#{hostId}, NOW(), #{title}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, '진행예정', #{thumbnailUrl}) RETURNING auction_id
INSERT INTO product (auc_key, prod_name) VALUES (#{aucKey}, #{prodName}) RETURNING prod_key
